title: fix(components): gate data-table row actions on requiredPermissions (objectui#9623)
body:
Fixes #9623

Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

`DataTableRowActionsMenu` (`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`) now
applies `useCapabilityGate` once to `schema.rowActionDefs`, before the menu is planned. That
is verbatim the posture `plugin-grid`'s `RowActionMenu` has taken for the standalone grid
since framework#3923, so the "⋮" trigger and the items it holds read ONE filtered source
and a row whose every action is gated away renders no trigger instead of an empty menu (the
objectui#3562 invariant).

Doctrine is untouched, deliberately: unknown still fails **OPEN**, an EMPTY reported set
gates normally, and the server remains the enforcement authority. This restores a UI MIRROR
of a decision the server already makes — no enforcement moved into the UI, and nothing new
is fetched or bound.

## ⭐ The card's diagnosis was falsified in its MECHANISM (its conclusion survives)

The card inferred that on the `list_item` mount `useHeldCapabilities()` resolves to
`undefined`, because the panel's action runtime does not carry `systemPermissions` into the
runner context. Measured on `origin/main` (`f0b49792`), that is not what happens:

1. **`useHeldCapabilities()` is never called on this path at all.** `data-table.tsx` had
   **zero** occurrences of `capabilit` / `requiredPermissions` / `mayInvoke` /
   `systemPermissions` — a lit control on the same file for `usePredicateScope` returns 4, so
   the zero is a reading and not a mistyped pattern. The gate was ABSENT on this renderer,
   not starved of data.
2. **The capability IS on the mount, and it arrives as `[]`, not as `undefined`.** The
   related list renders under the ActionProvider element `RecordDetailView` mounts itself,
   whose `context` prop carries `user: currentUser` and whose `resolveActionUser` seeds
   `systemPermissions` — the very provider the record surface one level up gates off.
   `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` is mounted inside it and feeds the child object's `list_item`
   actions in as `rowActionDefs`. The first case in the new pin reads the resolved set at
   exactly that mount and asserts `[]`, beside its twin asserting `undefined` when nothing
   reported a set.

⇒ The repair is this renderer consulting the gate that already exists. No new binding, and
the panel's runtime needed no threading — which is why the diff is one call site.

The observable half of the card is confirmed unchanged: same declaration, same build, gated
on `record_header` (`containers.tsx` filters `page:header` through the same hook) and inert
in the related-list rows.

**Not re-graded.** Nothing here measured a plain member's click SUCCEEDING, so this stays a
mirror gap rather than an execution hole. `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` was not opened.

## Reverse verification — the pin can go RED

Run from the committed state, mutation proven on disk by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in
the sibling `objectstack` checkout (anchor hit count 1 -> 0, blob `1cadfff6f8be` ->
`90ae0cb6d1d3`), then restored and verified byte-identical (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD`
empty):

| leg | result |
|---|---|
| with the gate (HEAD) | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 6 passed (6)` |
| gate ablated | `Test Files 1 failed (1)` · `Tests 2 failed, 4 passed (6)` |

The two that go red are the two that assert hiding. The measurement case stays green in both
legs on purpose — it describes the mount, not the fix.

equal to the working tree's 39, which is the same-source control for that enumeration).

| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) | 0 |

The `performance-budget` set's FIRST run exited **2** with "No console build to weigh at
apps/console/dist/assets" — that is NOT MEASURED and not a pass, so `@object-ui/console` and
its closure were built and those four were re-run; the row above is the second run.

**Declared narrowing:** repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` were NOT run locally — they are
CI's runs. The lint narrowing is the two changed files only. This repo has no formatting gate
and `eslint.config.js` carries correctness/ratchet rules, so a repo-wide ratchet count is not
something a two-file run can report, and that half is CI's.

## Acceptance notes — seen while measuring, NOT filed here and NOT touched here

- **The related-list TOOLBAR has the same gap, one surface over.**
  `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` derives `list_toolbar` actions through the same
  `deriveActions` with no capability gate, and `RelatedToolbarButton`
  (`packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`) evaluates only `action.visible` via
  `useCondition`; a `requiredPermissions` grep over that file returns 0 with `useCondition`
  at 3 as the lit control. The object-list toolbar one level up DOES gate
  (`EnvironmentListToolbar` filters `list_toolbar` through `mayInvoke`), so the two toolbar
  surfaces disagree. Same defect class as this card, different file and different package,
  and folding it in would add a whole new verification surface (`plugin-detail`) — so it is
  reported for the triage seat to file rather than repaired here. Dedupe words: related list
  toolbar, `list_toolbar`, `requiredPermissions`, `RelatedToolbarButton`, capability gate.
- The mobile branch of `RelatedList` renders `object-gallery` rather than `data-table` and
  carries no row actions at all, so it is not a second instance of this gap. Noted so the
  next reader does not go looking. Successor: none.
